parsed.explanation: Dossier shows no trans-specific criminalisation, border/facility exclusion, or documented police targeting affecting visitors. Strong self-legislating equality regime, legal gender recognition, gender-reassignment protection, conversion-therapy ban, decriminalised/gender-neutral sexual offences, marriage recognition, and official apologies indicate trans-respecting institutions and low likely severity after outing. Subnational variation and parent-state restrictions are absent. Remaining exposure is uncertainty rather than known danger: visitor-facing service enforcement, hate-crime bill status, custody/hospital placement, and violence data are not documented. Under rubric these open questions are lighter than known restrictions, but they prevent near-ideal low risk. Rating sits at the boundary of Reduced and Low Risk.
